introduction: Vella's Bordello offers paid temporary companions and can host wandering creatures whose materials are sought by quest givers in Winterhaven.
orientation: The approach from the Surface leads into the building's main rooms. Padh watches the entrance, and Vella keeps her own chamber deeper inside.
Vegar runs a shop among the private rooms. The fountain, corridors and treasure room offer places to explore.

Three of the house's workers offer to follow you as a temporary pet for a payment worth at least 500 copper. Pay the full amount at once; smaller payments do not accumulate toward the service. Their contact entries explain the offer once you have met them.

Incarnates sometimes roam through the house. Their remains are ingredients for Bipplewizzlille's five potion recipes in Winterhaven; each recipe also needs an empty potion bottle. These creatures are much stronger than the ordinary residents.

A wandering psychomia treant provides a plant sought by Buzzbeef in Winterhaven. His reward can then be taken to Thyz for a thieves' guild invitation. Branay also uses the plant in a separate nightshade recipe.

Follow these requests in Winterhaven's journal after visiting the city and meeting its quest givers. Materials supplied by another player work too; finding or defeating a creature here is not required for those hand-ins.

contacts.name: A sex crazed prostitute
contacts.description: A single payment worth at least 500 copper hires her to follow you as a temporary pet. The usual charm lasts ten minutes, subject to your existing pet-duration abilities. Smaller payments are kept without granting the hire.

contacts.name: The Incarnate of Fire
contacts.description: This wandering Incarnate leaves a burning flame when it dies. Bipplewizzlille in Winterhaven accepts the flame and an empty potion bottle for a fiery potion.

contacts.name: The Incarnate of Frost
contacts.description: This wandering Incarnate leaves a small snowflake when it dies. Bipplewizzlille in Winterhaven accepts the snowflake and an empty potion bottle for a frosty potion.

contacts.name: The Incarnate of Stone
contacts.description: This wandering Incarnate leaves a flint of granite when it dies. Bipplewizzlille in Winterhaven accepts the granite and an empty potion bottle for a granite potion.

contacts.name: The Incarnate of Air
contacts.description: This wandering Incarnate leaves a wisp of wind when it dies. Bipplewizzlille in Winterhaven accepts the wisp and an empty potion bottle for an acceleration potion.

contacts.name: The Incarnate of Mischief
contacts.description: This wandering Incarnate leaves a delicate bubble when it dies. Bipplewizzlille in Winterhaven accepts the bubble and an empty potion bottle for a protection potion.

contacts.name: A tall psychomia treant
contacts.description: This wandering treant leaves a psychomia plant when it dies. Buzzbeef in Winterhaven rewards the plant with coins and a small plastic bag; Thyz accepts that bag for an invitation. Branay has a separate recipe using a plant, nightshade and two gnomish shopkeepers tokens.
